sourceMirror.note: GeoJSON conversion mirror of U.S. Census 2020 county20 shapefile. NOT an official Census download endpoint; the upstream government ZIP is documented separately. No mirror code copied.

sourceCrs: NAD83 EPSG:4269 geographic lon/lat (retained; negligible WGS84 datum difference at county-scale visualization)

processing.method: Original Votatlas iterative Ramer-Douglas-Peucker over each closed ring, using two open chains and a Tennessee longitude cosine scale; keep original ring on collapse; no topology-specific shared-border snapping
processing.reproducibility: --check verifies committed bytes offline; --check-source fetches pinned upstream mirror and requires byte-for-byte exact regeneration; --write is deliberate network-based regeneration.

rights.governmentCopyright: U.S. federal-government-authored Census geographic data are not subject to copyright protection in the United States under 17 U.S.C. 105.
rights.sourceAcknowledgement: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census P.L. 94-171 TIGER/Line® county boundaries, Tennessee; simplified by Votatlas.
rights.trademark: TIGER/Line® is a registered U.S. Census Bureau mark; reference describes the source only, not Votatlas branding.
rights.noWarranty: Boundaries are for statistical data collection/tabulation and thematic mapping, not legal land descriptions, property rights, surveying, geocoding or precise area/perimeter computation.
rights.datasetStatus: Official federal geographic source, independently repackaged/approximated for visualization; NOT an election vote dataset and NOT endorsed by the Census Bureau.

assurances: 95 source GEOIDs match Tennessee Census 2020 county-reference file exactly
No proprietary ElectIndex code or geography was used
All candidate ballot counts remain fictional in separate tn-synthetic-v1 fixture
Simplification may create sub-pixel border slivers or alter tiny islands; use unsimplified official Census source for analytic area/adjacency.
